spots.text: in the lobby behind the curtains
asleep over a newspaper in the reading room
at the bottom of the gallery stairs
giving two reporters a quote in the foyer
in their office in the Halden Block
in a committee room in the Halden Block
at their desk in the Ferrier Building with the door shut
with a delegation from home in the Ferrier Building
on a long call in the Ferrier Building
in a cab on the airport road
on the shuttle to the terminal
at the gate with boarding called

found: {name} was {spot}, and came at a run.

lobby: {name} wasn't {spot} after all. Nobody had seen them.
Nobody in the lobbies had seen {name} for an hour.
office: {name}'s door was locked and the phone rang out.
{name} wasn't {spot}. Their assistant had no idea where they'd gone.
airport: By the time anyone got there, {name}'s flight was boarding.

log.oneIn: You sent for {name} during the bells on {bill}, and they made it in.
log.oneOut: You sent for {name} during the bells on {bill}. They didn't make it.
log.allIn: You sent for {n} during the bells on {bill} and got every one of them in.
log.someIn: You sent for {n} during the bells on {bill}; {k} made it in.
log.noneIn: You sent for {n} during the bells on {bill}. Nobody made it back.
